Retrieve Localized Optgroup Choices for Reliability Metric Selectors

Source: R/utils_reliability.R
get_reliability_metric_choices.Rd

Builds a grouped list of supported inter-rater reliability metric keys and localized display labels for use in shiny::selectInput().

Usage

get_reliability_metric_choices(lang = "en", include_all_core = TRUE)

Arguments

lang

Character language code ("de" or "en"). Defaults to "en".

include_all_core

Logical; whether to include the combined "all_core" overview option. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

A named list suitable for shiny::selectInput(..., choices = ...).

Examples

get_reliability_metric_choices(lang = "en")
#> $`Combined Overview`
#> $`Combined Overview`$`All Core Metrics (Accuracy, Kappa, Alpha, Iota², Gwet)`
